issues.description: The live crash path nested the canonical first-attempt builder output inside parsed and passed the exhausted Popen object instead of captured communicate() strings.
issues.reproduction: After control.communicate(), current_live_first_attempt(control) receives a Popen whose stdout/stderr are not captured strings; first_consume is not canonical.
issues.root_cause: live builder call-site and stale duplicated pre-evaluator decision logic
issues.fix: Build first_consume from control.returncode, captured so, and captured se; make evaluate_crash_case the sole load-bearing verdict path.
